svg.text: Office life: a day on the floor (schematic, not the engine)
Lively · owner-local time · two work days per person · real catalog personalities

Dark strip = at the desk (available; real work would pin them there). Thin bars = solo breaks · medium bars = huddles · tall bars with a marker = daily anchors (the habits you learn) · gold marker = crew huddle (Vy and Orla, water cooler ≈ 10:34).

Prototype of the rules only: sociability s and restlessness r from real catalog sliders and traits; spot preference approximated from sliders (the engine uses archetype blends). Movement is a picture of available time; real work, raised hands, rooms, calls and the owner's attention always override it (§2.9).
